title: media (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. Images, a video or a voice note in the reply: one item large with its caption, a grid or carousel of up to twelve, or an audio player with a waveform.

media.description: The file: `alt` is required. For video, `thumb` is the poster and `duration` its length; for audio, `duration`.

caption.description: Shown under the item: what it is and why it’s here. “Chicken satay bowl, Green Bowl. Photo from their menu.”

credit.description: Where it comes from when it isn’t the person’s: “Photo: StreetEasy”, “© Green Bowl”.

at.description: When it was taken or recorded.

waveform.description: For audio: amplitude samples 0–1, evenly spaced, drawn as bars that fill as it plays. Without it the client draws a plain bar, never a made-up wave.

transcript.description: For audio and video: what is said, as text under the player (folded after four lines).

items.description: One image, video or audio file with its caption.
The media, in the order to show. Images and videos can mix; audio items are shown as players, one under another, and don’t mix with images.

layout.description: auto: one item → single, two or more → grid, audio → players. carousel: one at a time with page dots and a caption per item.
